docs/usage/README.md, docs/adr/README.md and docs/development/README.md each start with a one-sentence purpose and list every other document in their directory once with a description; no other document under docs repeats a document list (searched for list items linking documents outside the indexes).

Their durable content is maintained in docs/usage/authoring.md, docs/usage/author-format.md, docs/usage/installation.md, docs/development/architecture.md, docs/development/release.md and ADRs 0001 and 0002; their only links were the development index entries, which were removed.

The Status lines of ADRs 0003, 0005, 0006, 0007, 0008 and 0009, which recorded grilling dates, implementing issues, PRs and releases, were removed; ADR 0007 keeps its "Amends ADR 0005" relationship. The dated status narrative at the top of docs/development/architecture.md, the issue #11, #1 and #31 narratives in docs/development/release.md and its link to a removed coverage map were removed.

docs/development/architecture.md now states that fresh adoption over installed content also removes a system skill a different CLI version installed, matching the shipped behavior observed in this run (SYSTEM_SKILL_CONFLICT for the CLI 1.2.2 skill) and docs/usage/adoption.md "Adopt afresh over installed content".

Every relative Markdown link and anchor in README.md, CONTEXT.md, docs and acceptance/README.md resolves (local link scan), including acceptance/README.md to docs/development/release.md#published-acceptance.

declarations.explanation: README.md follows the v0.3.0 Repository README guidance: centered title, a one-sentence description that says what the project is, language and runtime badges, a version-free install command, one-line verb-led Features, one usage example, and link-only Documentation, Contributing and License sections.
evidence: The description now reads "A CLI and agent skills for publishing and applying versioned repository standards.", matching package.json bin entries and the skills directory.
Installation runs npm install --global --ignore-scripts @lutzseverino/repo-standards without a version, followed by repo-standards --version.
Badges are TypeScript (the implementation language) and Node.js 24 (the runtime, with its required major version from package.json engines).
Each Features item is one line starting with a verb: Validate, Inspect, Adopt, Update, Report, Discover; the update item previously began with the adverb Deliberately and now starts with its verb.

Documentation, Contributing and License each hold only a plain paragraph link: [Documentation](docs/README.md), [Contribution guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md), [MIT License](LICENSE), matching the MIT LICENSE file.

The author format and architecture contracts links moved from the Documentation section into the Usage prose; the release-notes note is already in docs/usage/installation.md and the Repo Canon neutrality note moved to docs/agents/project.md.

pnpm release:pack succeeds and test/release.test.ts passes: the packed README keeps docs/usage links relative and rewrites architecture.md, docs/README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md to absolute repository URLs on main.
